title: How the Private Access App Connector support troubleshooting runbook is organized and which pages cover each topic
aliases: Private Access App Connector Support Troubleshooting Runbook

prose.label: Runbook pages.
prose.text: Enrollment failures are in [[zpa.app-connectors.runbook.enrollment]], upgrade problems and rebuilds are in [[zpa.app-connectors.runbook.upgrades]], Public Service Edge connectivity is in [[zpa.app-connectors.runbook.connectivity]], and CPU, memory and disk checks are in [[zpa.app-connectors.runbook.resources]]. The sizing, DNS and ping checks that precede the connectivity and high-utilization checks are in [[zpa.app-connectors.runbook.enrollment]].

topics.statement: The App Connector support runbook's key topics are resolving enrollment failures, addressing upgrade challenges, troubleshooting Public Service Edge connectivity issues, and managing high CPU, memory and disk utilization concerns.

quotes: Troubleshooting Public Service Edge connectivity issues.
Managing high CPU, memory, and disk utilization concerns.
